caption: Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
composition: Museumplein looking north at Cuypers’ south facade, corner towers, and the open underpass · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From Museumplein the view looks north at the Rijksmuseum’s south facade. Red brick is crossed by pale stone bands. Two square corner towers with spires frame an open central arched underpass, with ornate gables above it. It is night, about 20.5°C, under full cloud with moderate drizzle. The square is wet grass and paths, without a letter sculpture.
